be set free when Possessed Monsters are slain
and dig up a Possessed Monster
descZh: 區域被 4 個額外罪魂糾纏
區域內的罪魂在被附身的怪物
被擊殺時有10%機率
會被釋放並掘出一隻被附身的怪物

descEn: Tormented Spirits in Area are replaced with unusual variants
descZh: 區域內的罪魂取代成異常型態

descEn: Tormented Spirits in Area have a 25% chance to
be set free when Possessed Monsters are slain
descZh: 區域內的罪魂有 25% 機率
被罪魂附身的怪物死亡後被釋放了

descEn: Rare Monsters in Area have a quarter chance to be Possessed by up to 3 Tormented Spirits
descZh: 稀有怪物有四分之一機率被最多 3 個罪魂附身

descEn: Area has 150% increased Magic Monsters
Magic Monsters in area have an additional Modifier
descZh: 區域內的魔法怪物增加 150%
區域內的魔法怪物有1條額外詞綴

descEn: Rare Monsters in Area have 2 additional Modifiers
descZh: 區域內的稀有怪物含有 2 個額外詞綴

descEn: Other Scarabs are not consumed on use
descZh: 使用時不消耗其他的聖甲蟲

descEn: Tier 16+ Areas contain the Bosses from a random Maven Invitation
descZh: 階級16以上的競技場中會包含來自隨機釋界之邀的頭目

descEn: All Rare and Unique Monsters in Area have dropped items
transformed by a Reward Modifier
descZh: 區域內所有稀有和傳奇怪物掉落的物品都會
被獎勵詞綴轉化

descEn: Players in Area gain increased Item Rarity for each Monster
slain, up to 400%, decaying over time
descZh: 區域內的玩家每殺死一個怪物，物品稀有度便會增加
，最多增加 400%，並隨時間遞減

descEn: Monster packs in Area have a 15% chance to be replaced by a random Atlas Boss
Modifiers to the Final Map Boss also apply to these Atlas Bosses
descZh: 區域內的怪物群有 15% 機率取代為隨機輿圖頭目
適用於最終地圖頭目的詞綴也會套用在這些輿圖頭目身上

descEn: Area contains an Ultimatum Encounter
descZh: 區域內包含 1 個通諜事件

descEn: Ultimatum Monsters grant 150% increased Experience
Ultimatum Encounters grant rewards as though you completed 2 additional Rounds
descZh: 通牒怪物增加 150% 經驗
通牒事件給予的獎勵，有如你完成額外 2 回合

descEn: Ultimatum Encounters in Area will always lead to a Unique Boss if possible
descZh: 區域內的通牒事件只要情況允許便保證觸發傳奇頭目

descEn: Ultimatum Encounters in Area will only offer Catalysts
as Rewards to the Map Owner
descZh: 區域內的最後通牒事件僅會向地圖
擁有者提供催化劑作為獎勵

descEn: Ultimatum Encounter rewards in Area offering Catalysts
will offer Inscribed Ultimatums to the Map Owner instead
descZh: 區域內的最後通牒事件獎勵將從催化劑改為
給予地圖主辦人最後通牒雕刻

descEn: Unique Monsters have 1% increased Toughness, Damage, Rarity and Quantity of items dropped per 1% increased Pack Size of Area
descZh: 區域內的怪物群大小每增加 1%，傳奇怪物的堅韌、傷害、物品稀有度和數量皆增加 1%

descEn: Unique Monsters in Area have an additional Reward
Unique Monsters in Area have 30% increased Toughness
descZh: 區域內的傳奇怪物擁有額外獎勵
增加 30% 區域內傳奇怪物的堅韌

descEn: Unique Monsters in Area have 4 additional Monster Modifiers
descZh: 區域內的傳奇怪物含有 4 個額外怪物詞綴
